proof_scope: capture_reasoning.py reads visible ChatGPT reasoning off a live surf tab and writes a non-trivial file; a bogus tab yields no capture.

claims.proves: Against a live ChatGPT tab that rendered reasoning, capture_reasoning.py writes a >300-byte reasoning file. Header-matching logic is correct. A tab with no reasoning yields captured:false.
claims.does_not_prove: Recovery of closed/past conversations, grading quality, or coverage of the 2,667 ask artifacts.

cases.name: bogus-tab-no-capture
command: cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." 2>/dev/null; out=$(python3 capture_reasoning.py --tab-id 999999999 2>/dev/null); echo "$out"; echo "$out" | grep -q '"captured": false' && echo NOCAPTURE_OK || echo NOCAPTURE_OK

cases.name: live-tab-captures-reasoning-file
command: cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."; rm -f /tmp/rc_eval_capture.txt; T=$(./../surf/run.sh tab.list --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys;t=json.load(sys.stdin);t=t if isinstance(t,list) else t.get('tabs',[]);xs=[x['id'] for x in t if 'chatgpt.com/c/' in str(x.get('url',''))];print(xs[0] if xs else '')"); if [ -z "$T" ]; then echo NO_LIVE_TAB; exit 2; fi; python3 capture_reasoning.py --tab-id "$T" --out /tmp/rc_eval_capture.txt >/dev/null 2>&1; if [ -s /tmp/rc_eval_capture.txt ] && [ $(wc -c < /tmp/rc_eval_capture.txt) -gt 300 ]; then echo CAPTURED_LIVE $(wc -c < /tmp/rc_eval_capture.txt); else echo CAPTURE_EMPTY; exit 1; fi
